verses.en: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.sm: Atua lona lava nuu? Aua neʻi faapea; aua foi o le Isaraelu aʻu nei, o le fanau a Aperaamo, o le itu aiga o Peniamina.

verses.en: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying,
verses.sm: E lei lafoaiina e le Atua lona nuu na ia silafia anamua. Ua outou le iloa ea le mea ua fai mai ai le Tusi i le tala ia Elia? ina ua momoli atu e ia ia Isaraelu i le Atua, ua faapea atu,

verses.en: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
verses.sm: Le Alii e, ua fasiotia e i latou au perofeta, ma ua sóloia ou fata faitaulaga; na o au lava ua toe, ua latou saili for e fasioti ia te au.

verses.en: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.
verses.sm: A ua faapefea ea le tali mai ale Atua ia te ia? Ua ou faatoe mo'u e toafitugaafe o tagata, o e ua le tootuli lava ia Paala.

verses.en: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
verses.sm: O lenei, e faapea foi i nei ona po, ua i ai e ua totoe e tusa ma le filifiliga o le alofa tunoa.

verses.en: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
verses.sm: Afai foi o le alofa tunoa, ua le o galuega; ana faapea, po ua le toe ta‘ualofatunoaina le alofa tunoa.

verses.en: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded
verses.sm: O lenei, pe faapefea ea? E lei maua e Isaraelu le mea ua ia sailia, a ua maua E i latou ua filifilia, a ua faamaaaina loto o e ua totoe.

verses.en: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.
verses.sm: Pei ona tusia, Ua tuu atu e le Atua ia te i latou le loto moe gase, o mata latou te le vaai ai, ma taliga latou te le faalogo ai, ua 00 1 ona po nei.

verses.en: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:
verses.sm: Ua fai mai foi Tavita, Za liua la latou la‘o‘ai ma mailei, ma matásele, ma mea e tausuai ai, ia fai foi ma taui ia te i latou;

verses.en: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.
verses.sm: ia faapouliuligia o latou mata ina ia le vaai, ia faano‘uno‘u o latou tua e le aunoa.

verses.en: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.
verses.sm: O lenei, ou te fai atu, Ua tausuai ea i latou ina ia latou pauu? Aua neʻi faapea; a o la latou agasala, ua oo ai le ola i nuu ese, e faatupu ai lo latou losilosi.

verses.en: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
verses.sm: A e afai ua fai la latou agasala ma tamaoaiga o le lalolagi, afai foi ua fai le faamativaina o i latou ma tamaoaiga o nuu ese, e le atili ai ea ona faapea o lo latou manuia?

verses.en: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:
verses.sm: Aua ou te fai atu ia te outou o nuu ese, ana o a'u o le aposetolo o nuu ese, ou te vivii i Jo'u faiva;

verses.en: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.
verses.sm: pe mafai ia te au ona faatupuina le losilosi i lo'u nuu, ma ou faaolaina nisi o i latou.

verses.en: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
verses.sm: Aua afai ua maua le leleiga e le lalolagi ina ua lafoaiina i latou, pe faapefea lo latou amiga? E le o le ola ea lea nai e ua oti?

verses.en: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.
verses.sm: Afai foi e paia mea faapolopoloina, e faapea foi le paluga uma; a paia le pogai, e faapea foi ona la.

verses.en: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;
verses.sm: Afai foi na gaui ese nisi ona la, a o oe o le olive vao, ua faapipiiina oe ia faatasi ma i latou, ma ua tofu faatasi ma i latou i le pogai ma le sua o le olive,

verses.en: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.
verses.sm: aua e te faasiasia i ona la ; afai foi e te faasiasia, ia e manatu ua le ola le pogai ia te oe, a ua e ola i le pogai.

verses.en: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.
verses.sm: Anei e te faapea mai, Ua gauieseina ona la, ina ia faapipiiina ai aʻu.

verses.en: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:
verses.sm: Mālie; a ua gauieseina i latou ona o le le faatuatua, a o loo tumau oe ona o le faatuatua; aua e te faamaualuga, a ia e fefe.

verses.en: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.
verses.sm: Auā afai ua le faasaoina e le Atua o la na tupu mai ai, o le a le faasaoina foi oe.

verses.en: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.
verses.sm: Faauta foi i le agamalu ma le toasa o le Atua; o e na pauu E 00 ai le toasa; a e oo ia te oe le agamalu, pe afai e te tumau pea i lona agamalu; a le faapea e gauieseina oe.

verses.en: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.
verses.sm: O i latou foi, pe afai e le tumau pea i le le faatuatua, e toe faapipiina i latou; auā e mafaia e le Atua ona toe faapipiiina i latou.

verses.en: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?
verses.sm: Aua afai ua salaeseina oe nai le olive vao, na e tupu mai ai, ma ua faapipiina oe i le olive lelei, na e le tupu mai ai. o le a atili ai ona toe faapipiiina gofie o la na tupu mai ai i lo latou lava olive.

verses.en: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.
verses.sm: Aua le au uso e, ou te loto ina ia outou iloa lenei mea lilo, ina neʻi tou faafiapopoto; ua faamaaaina loto o isi Isaraelu, seia 00 ina ulufale mai le atoatoa o nuu ese;

verses.en: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:
verses.sm: ona faaolaina lea o Isaraelu atoa uma, pei ona tusia, E maliu mai le Faaola mai Siona, na te faateaseina le amio faalematau ia Iakopo;

verses.en: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
verses.sm: o laʻu foi lenei feagaiga ma i latou, pe a aveeseina e aʻu a latou agasala.

verses.en: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers' sakes.
verses.sm: O fili; latou i la le tala lelei, ona o outou; a ua alofaina i latou i la le filifiliga, ona o tupuga.

verses.en: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.
verses.sm: Auā e le salamo lava le Atua i ana mea E foaifuaina mai ma lana valaau.

verses.en: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:
verses.sm: Auā faapei o outou foi, sa outou le faalogo anamua i le Atua, a o lenei, ua alofaina outou ona ua latou le faalogo;

verses.en: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
verses.sm: e faapea foi i latou ua latou le faalogo i nei ona po, ina ia alofaina i latou foi ona o le alcfaina o outou.

verses.en: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
verses.sm: Aua ua punitia ẹ le Atua tagata uma lava i le le faalogo, ina ia alofaina e ia tagata uma lave.

verses.en: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
verses.sm: Aut! le loloto o le tamaoaiga o le poto atoa ma le silafaga a le Atua. E le masuesueina ana faamasinoga; e le mafai foi ona iloa ona ala.

verses.en: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
verses.sm: Aud o ai ea se ua iloa le finagalo o le Alii? Po o ai foi se ua pulega faatasi ma ia?

verses.en: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
verses.sm: Po o ai se na muai avatua ni mea ia te ia, a e tauia mai ai ia te ia?

verses.en: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
verses.sm: Aua ua fua mai ia te ia, ma ua faia e ia, ẹ iu atu foi ia te ja mea uma; ia ia te ia le viiga e faavavau lava.
